svg.aria-label: Aloul Wallace-Tree Multiplier Integer Factoring SAT Architecture

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Parallel 3:2 Carry-Save Adder (CSA) tree reduction in O(log₃/₂ n) depth · 15 SAT semiprimes (n ∈ {19, 20, 21}-bit primes, randomly reordered)
Wallace 3:2 Carry-Save Reduction Tree (6×6 Bit-Column Schematic of n×n)
Groups of 3 bits per column compress in parallel (FA: 3→2, HA: 2→2) until height ≤ 2 for final CPA
Final Carry-Propagate Adder (CPA: 2 rows → 2n-bit product P = p × q)
Depth recurrence: ht+1 ≤ ⌈2·ht / 3⌉ ⇒ O(log₃/₂ n) layers
Total native XORs: 9,085 · ρcrit = 1.36× · κ = 0.97 · 8% Bin
